race.comment: OFFICIAL BUSINESS (6) finished runner-up by a neck as the favourite at Northam nearly 2 weeks ago and is trial form has always been that of a horse that can win some races, so with any luck from a wide gate, he can go one better here. OUR MANE MAN (7) won a trial prior to finishing second here a fortnight ago over 1200m by less than a length. He has to overcome a tougher draw this time, but strips fitter, and he can figure in the top 3 again. JEMCONI (5) was a sound fourth as the favourite when resuming from a spell here and had won a trial very comfortably before that. She dons the blinkers for the first time, and it is only her wide gate that will prevent her from going close to taking this out. DIAMOND JACK (3) has been given plenty of time to make his debut, and he looked forward in condition when winning his latest trial at Lark. Follow any market confidence, as he too is drawn off the track. WINTER BLOOM (11) may have found that his last run had come too soon for him.
